To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

exotic (i.e., built of two or three quark-antiqueark pairs) tensor and axial-vector mesons make significant contributions to the matrix elements of the QCD energy-momentum tensor, that this conclusion is in agreement with the predictions of meson dominance models, and that it is in agreement with exchange degeneracy.
exotic mesons make large, previously unaccounted-for contributions to the hadronic energy-momentum tensor, and that the exchange degeneracy of hadrons, a long-standing puzzle, is resolved.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the structure and interactions of the lightest mesons.
the structure of the nucleon and its relation to the structure of the quark-antiquer pair.
the structure and properties of exotic mesons.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the exotic mesons have not been observed yet but they are not far away.
the energy momentum tensor is not a good probe of the quark structure of the nucleon.
the energy-momentum operator is the most important operator of the hadronic world and that it is a very powerful tool in understanding hadron structure and interactions.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the energy-momentum of the hadrons can be described in terms of the quarks and gluons, but the quark-gluon description must be supplemented with exotic mesons.
the exotic mesons are the key to the understanding of the structure and interactions of the baryons and of the hadronic matter in general.
the exotic meson contributions to the hadronic matrix elements of the traceless energy momentum tensor is about 1.3 times that of the non-exotic contributions.
The main takeaway from our work is that
exotic mesons can have large couplings to ordinary hadrons.
the exotic meson sector is much richer than previously thought, and that exotic mesons are important for understanding hadronic structure.
the energy momentum tensor is a powerful tool for probing hadron structure, and that exotic mesons play a crucial role in the dynamics of the strong interaction.
